title: A stale session stops haunting octowright_status
body: A stale session that outlived its daemon no longer haunts octowright_status forever. The cleanup only asked whether the recorded pid was still alive, and the OS recycles pids — one entry here was kept for four weeks because its dead daemon's pid had become a shell. It now checks that the process is actually an octowright daemon.

title: A tail summary says when it covers only part of the file
body: A tail recording summary says when it only covers part of the file. 0.15.0 bounded the read so a huge recording could not be pulled into the daemon whole, which quietly made event_count describe one window rather than the recording — so it read as a total when it was not.
